Settlement Demand
October 17, 2024
Claims Department
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Re: Claim C-1402 - Demand for settlement
Dear Claims Representative:
Our office represents Samantha Fowler in connection with the rear-end collision that
occurred on November 18, 2023. Our client was stopped at a traffic signal when the
insured vehicle srtuck the rear of their car at a speed sufficient to cuase significant
impact. The police report documents the collision and identifies your insured as the
driver who failed to stop in time, and the physical damage to our client's vehicle is
consistent with that account.
As a direct result of the impact, our client suffered a whiplash inujry to the neck and
upper back. Following the collision, our client sought prompt mediacl evaluation and
has since undergone a course of physical therapy and follow-up care. Our client
continues to experience stiffness, headaches, and limited range of motion, and the
treating physician has noted that recovery may be lengthy. Medical records and billing
statements are enclosed.
Liability in this matter is clear. Your insured owed a duty to maintain a safe
following distance and to keep a proper lookout, and that duty was breached. Our client
has incurred medical expenses, lost wages, and considerable pain and suffering as a
result.
We therefore demand payment of $233,000.00 to resolve all claims against your insured
arising from this collision. This offer will remain open for thirty days from the date
of this letter. If we do not receive a satisfactory response within that period, we are
prepared to file suit without further notice.
Expert review: Anthony Davis, neurologist
Sincerely,
Jennifer Williams
Conley & Stephenson Law Group
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
